datasets.name: MateriaViva Open
datasets.description: Cross-database crystal index with structures, source-linked property values, curves and separate model predictions.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source
datasets.license: Per row: CC BY 4.0, CC0 1.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, public domain, or MIT (provider declarations)

sources.title: MateriaViva Open — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Card reports 10,903,588 included structures from a 14,590,485-structure pool spanning 55 databases; 290,118 included structures are tagged experimental.

caveats: An aggregate overlapping most parent databases; never add it to their totals.

Provider reports 2,471,566 stored CIFs with origin_open=false: a matching fingerprint exists in an open source, but the actual stored coordinates came from another or unrecorded source. Filter origin_open for coordinate-source traceability.
Fingerprint deduplication and per-row licensing are provider claims, not independently audited here.
Model predictions are distinct from measured or DFT-computed property values.

additional_counts.scope: Spectra, DOS and band structure records; separate from structure count

datasets.name: LeMat-Bulk
datasets.description: Standardized outputs from Materials Project, Alexandria and OQMD, with functional-compatibility subsets.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: LeMat-Bulk — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Dataset card and config metadata report 6,725,590 structure records representing 5,860,446 materials; PBE compatible subset has 5,335,299 rows.

caveats: 6,725,590 records are not 6,725,590 distinct materials.
Combines upstream databases; energy corrections and computational settings need subset-aware handling.
This is the non-unique collection; use BulkUnique for the corresponding fingerprint-deduplicated release.

datasets.name: LeMat-BulkUnique
datasets.description: Fingerprint-deduplicated companion to LeMat-Bulk.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: LeMat-BulkUnique — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Card table lists 5,438,436 all records: 5,005,017 PBE, 15,753 PBEsol, and 417,666 SCAN.

caveats: Includes functional-specific subsets; the sum must not be described as a count of experimentally known compounds.
Overlaps LeMat-Bulk and all three source databases.

datasets.name: Alexandria
datasets.description: High-throughput inorganic structure database, with separate functional releases, trajectories and convex-hull subsets.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: Alexandria — primary documentation
sources.evidence: 2026 expansion paper reports approximately 5.8 million structures; provider release page lists the complete PBE database dated 2025-07-02.

caveats: The figure describes a release, not a live recount or all trajectories.
Convex-hull stability is computed relative to the reference set; synthesis and dynamical stability require separate evidence.

datasets.name: AFLOW
datasets.description: High-throughput DFT library of inorganic crystals, alloys and prototype decorations.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source
datasets.license: Provider terms: free for scientific, academic and non-commercial use; other use prohibited

sources.title: AFLOW — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Live statistics response gives Aflow_DBs.total.count=3,929,948 and 205,973 chemical systems.

sources.title: AFLOW documentation and data disclaimer
sources.evidence: The data disclaimer limits free use to scientific, academic and non-commercial purposes.

caveats: Entries and calculated properties are different counters.
The open-source software license is not the data license; see AFLOW API disclaimer.
Contains hypothetical and experimentally seeded structures, with overlaps across databases.

datasets.name: OQMD
datasets.description: Open Quantum Materials Database of DFT thermodynamic and structural properties.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: OQMD — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Official homepage indexed text reports 1,407,395 materials.

caveats: Count verified in provider search-index content; direct HTTP fetch returned 502 during this audit.
Predominantly computed entries, including prototype decorations; not a count of experimental discoveries.

datasets.name: GNoME released stable-materials set
datasets.description: Public structure release accompanying Graph Networks for Materials Exploration.
datasets.version: Public stable-materials set; June 2024 overlap update
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source
datasets.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (data); Apache 2.0 applies to code

sources.title: GNoME released stable-materials set — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Author DATASET.md describes approximately 381,000 novel structures and a summary revised to reduce overlap with June 2024 external database snapshots.

caveats: Ranked by the released novel stable-materials set, not the paper headline of 2.2 million candidate crystals.
Stability and novelty depend on the calculation protocol and reference database snapshots.
Non-commercial data license; do not inherit the repository code license.

datasets.name: Carolina Materials Database
datasets.description: Generated and computationally screened inorganic crystals hosted by the Carolina Materials Database.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: Carolina Materials Database — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Provider homepage states 214,436 inorganic materials and separately more than 250,000 calculated properties.

caveats: Generated candidates and calculated properties do not establish experimental synthesis.
Homepage text contains typographical space-group wording; no inference about full space-group coverage is made.

datasets.name: Materials Project
datasets.description: Structure-centered computed properties for inorganic materials with API and bulk distribution routes.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 for core data; GNoME-origin data carry separate BY-NC acceptance

sources.title: Materials Project — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Provider homepage snapshot reports 200,487 materials and identifies database v2026.04.13.

sources.title: Materials Project database versions
sources.evidence: Version history documents separate BY-NC acceptance for the GNoME dataset and changes in collection membership.

caveats: A dated provider-page figure, not an authenticated query of the latest live database.
Different property collections cover different subsets; molecule and electrode totals are separate.
Track GNoME-origin licensing and database version when using API data.

datasets.name: JARVIS-DFT 3D
datasets.description: NIST first-principles bulk materials collection with electronic, elastic and related property labels.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: JARVIS-DFT 3D — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Official downloader describes the dft_3d release as 76k and points to jdft_3d-12-12-2022.json.

sources.title: JARVIS-DFT 3D Figshare metadata
sources.evidence: Identifies the 2022-12-12 bulk data file and the CC BY 4.0 data license.

caveats: Version-pinned bulk downloader count; not a live tally of every JARVIS family database.
Individual properties are available for subsets; JARVIS-2D and specialized cohorts are listed separately.

datasets.name: Materials Cloud 3D (MC3D)
datasets.description: Reproducible DFT geometries seeded from experimental crystallography with complete AiiDA provenance.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: Materials Cloud 3D (MC3D) — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Primary paper reports 72,589 curated unique stoichiometric input structures and 32,013 optimized structures in PBEsol-v2.

caveats: 32,013 is the optimized release, not the larger curated input set.
Computed relaxed coordinates derived from experimental sources; not new experimental measurements.

datasets.name: LeMat-Traj
datasets.description: Standardized relaxation trajectories from Materials Project, Alexandria and OQMD.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: LeMat-Traj — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Config metadata and datasets-server API report 112,932,152 PBE, 7,259,866 PBEsol, 497,451 r2SCAN, 172,366 SCAN and 412,623 non-compatible rows; their sum is 121,274,458.

sources.title: LeMat-Traj dataset server metadata
sources.evidence: API corroborates each of the five config row counts used in the sum.

caveats: Count is derived by summing the five configuration-row counts, not the number of parent crystals.
Narrative per-source tables in the card disagree with config metadata; the ranking uses metadata corroborated by the datasets-server API.
Large overlap with Alexandria trajectories, MPtrj and upstream databases.

count_derivation.method: sum of five published config row counts

datasets.name: Open Materials 2024 (OMat24)
datasets.description: Non-equilibrium inorganic DFT data generated through rattling, AIMD and relaxation.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: Open Materials 2024 (OMat24) — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Card reports 100,824,585 training and 1,025,361 corrected validation configurations for OMat24 itself.

caveats: Rank uses explicitly listed main train+validation rows; the paper headline >110 million calculations has a broader scope.
sAlex is hosted on the same card and listed separately here; the 1M subsplit is not additional data.
Original validation data contained duplicates; corrected validation was uploaded 2024-12-20.

count_derivation.method: train + corrected validation; excludes sAlex and overlapping 1M subsplit

datasets.name: ELEMENTA public core release
datasets.description: Low-prior DFT-labeled atomic configurations with explicitly bounded composition coverage.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: ELEMENTA public core release — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Public card describes nearly 39 million core frames and a separate complete 4.7 million-frame Spin archive.

caveats: This public subset is smaller than the full 210-million-frame corpus described by the authors.
Nearly 39 million is a rounded provider figure; archives were not downloaded or independently counted.
Separate Spin archive is not included in this row.

datasets.name: ELEMENTA Spin
datasets.description: DFT-resolved magnetic initializations distributed alongside ELEMENTA.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: ELEMENTA Spin — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Card identifies the separate ELEMENTA_spin.extxyz archive as the complete 4.7 million-frame Spin dataset.

caveats: Magnetic initializations are configurations, not 4.7 million distinct crystals.
Shares the ELEMENTA family and hosting page.

datasets.name: sAlex25
datasets.description: Alexandria subset for interatomic-potential training from structural relaxation paths.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: sAlex25 — primary documentation
sources.evidence: 2026 primary expansion paper describes sAlex25 as 14 million out-of-equilibrium structures containing forces and stresses.

caveats: Version differs from the sAlex supplied with OMat24; versions and parent trajectories overlap.
Do not add trajectory frames to the Alexandria equilibrium-structure total.

datasets.name: sAlex (OMat24 distribution)
datasets.description: Subsampled Alexandria trajectories supplied with the OMat24 release.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: sAlex (OMat24 distribution) — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Card lists sAlex train=10,447,765 and validation=553,218.

caveats: Separate from the main OMat24 generated data, but overlaps Alexandria and later sAlex releases.

datasets.name: Materials Project Trajectory (MPtrj)
datasets.description: Selected GGA/GGA+U static and relaxation frames used to train CHGNet.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: Materials Project Trajectory (MPtrj) — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Figshare description gives 1,580,395 structures and energies from MP version 2022.9; record license is MIT.

caveats: Frames derive from roughly 146k parent compounds; not 1.58 million materials.
Missing magnetic moments are null, not zero; stress sign and units need explicit conversion.
Overlaps the source MP database and LeMat trajectories.

datasets.name: MP-ALOE
datasets.description: Active-learning r2SCAN data emphasizing off-equilibrium inorganic structures.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: MP-ALOE — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Primary paper reports 909,792 frames from 303,264 three-step structure relaxations, covering 89 elements.

caveats: The approximately 100 million generated candidates are a selection pool, not the DFT-labeled release.
Paper data-availability section gives the distribution route; exact dataset license was not verified in this audit.

datasets.name: MatPES
datasets.description: Compact potential-energy-surface data sampled from extensive MD and labeled with PBE and r2SCAN.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: MatPES — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Author repository describes the initial 2025.1 release as about 400,000 structures; 2025.2 adds charge labels and removes a small number of duplicates.

caveats: 400k is a rounded original-release reference; exact 2025.2 rows were not independently verified.
281 million MD snapshots are the sampling pool, not 281 million DFT configurations.
PBE and r2SCAN labels must not be counted as twice as many independent geometries.

datasets.name: ALIGNN-FF training dataset
datasets.description: JARVIS-derived force-field training structures and force labels.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: ALIGNN-FF training dataset — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Primary ALIGNN-FF paper reports 307,113 energies and 3,197,795 force labels across 72,708 compounds.

caveats: Configuration count differs from parent-compound count and force-component count.
Overlaps the JARVIS structure family.

datasets.name: Massive Atomic Diversity (MAD-1.5)
datasets.description: Compact all-electron r2SCAN dataset spanning crystals, surfaces, clusters and molecules.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source
datasets.license: Not verified for this archived version

sources.title: Massive Atomic Diversity (MAD-1.5) — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Table 1 reports 216,803 structures across 14 subsets; the set contains both periodic and isolated configurations.

caveats: Includes isolated atoms, dimers, trimers and molecules; count is not periodic crystals alone.
Non-spin-polarized electronic-structure settings limit magnetic applications.
Newer MAD-1.6 archive is tracked separately; revisions overlap.

datasets.name: Massive Atomic Diversity (MAD-1.6)
datasets.description: Updated mixed-domain r2SCAN reference set with a compatible PBE subset.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: Massive Atomic Diversity (MAD-1.6) — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Archive README identifies MAD-1.6 train/validation/test and rejected-frame files, plus a PBE subset; no independently verified total used here.

sources.title: MAD-1.6 Materials Cloud metadata
sources.evidence: Archive rights metadata identify CC BY 4.0; this audit did not recount the configuration payloads.

caveats: A current archive exists, but total frame count has not been verified; do not substitute the MAD-1.5 total.
Rejected frames and PBE recomputations should not be added blindly to r2SCAN geometry counts.

datasets.name: MPF.2021.2.8
datasets.description: Selected Materials Project snapshots used for the universal M3GNet potential.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: MPF.2021.2.8 — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Primary DIRECT-sampling paper states 187,687 ionic steps from 62,783 MP compounds as of 2021-02-08.

caveats: A subset of MP trajectories, not an independent collection of new compounds.
Figshare notes version reversion and pymatgen compatibility requirements.

datasets.name: OpenLAM TrainingSet
datasets.description: Multitask collection for large atomistic models covering solids, surfaces, liquids and molecular systems.
datasets.version: OpenLAM-TrainingSet-v1 (2025); later model variants use revised collections
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: OpenLAM TrainingSet — primary documentation
sources.evidence: LAMBench and DPA-3 primary documentation identify AIS Square as the public training-set distribution; no consistently verified total was extracted.

caveats: Collection overlaps upstream public datasets and includes non-crystal domains.
Model parameter counts (3M, 5M, 7M) are not dataset sizes.
License and downloadable counts must be checked for the selected component/version.

datasets.name: LeMat-Rho
datasets.description: r2SCAN crystal structures with charge density grids and atom-resolved charge labels.
datasets.count_scope: Release described by the cited source

sources.title: LeMat-Rho — primary documentation
sources.evidence: Card reports 69,117 materials, Bader charges for 59,613 and unsmoothed charge density for 65,960.

caveats: Label coverage differs by column; 69,117 does not imply complete Bader labels.
Derived from structures with AFLOW, OQMD and MP identifiers.

sources.evidence: Code-agnostic raw and normalized computational and experimental archives. Provider snapshot reports 19,425,275 entries and 4,346,100 represented materials; these heterogeneous counters are not a count of unique bulk crystals.

resources.description: Primary paper makes the bridging DFT data available through this deposit. Distinguish recomputed bridging structures from the 15 overlapping source datasets and their mixed-domain frame total.

searches: LeMaterial official datasets and Hugging Face release metadata
OMat24 main and sAlex split counts
Alexandria expansion paper and official versioned downloads
Primary inorganic database statistics and data terms
MLIP training sets versus model-only availability
